name: maui-threading
description: Multi-threaded programming patterns in GnollHack's .NET MAUI frontend. Covers thread architecture, lock strategies (Monitor.TryEnter, lock, Interlocked), the IThreadSafeView pattern, ConcurrentQueue-based inter-thread communication, and platform-specific GPU rendering thread behavior.
author: hyvanmielenpelit
readme:
# GnollHack

## Introduction

GnollHack is a turn-based, traditional roguelike game built upon the codebase of the classic roguelike game [NetHack](https://github.com/NetHack/NetHack).

### Key Features

- **Modern GUI** — Animated graphics, sound effects, music, and voiceovers
- **Cross-platform** — Native support for Android, iOS, and Windows

## Reporting an Issue

Please report issues on the [GnollHack Discord server](https://discord.gg/cQuExnzUQy).

## More Information

- **[GnollHack wiki](https://wiki.gnollhack.com/)** — More information about GnollHack
- **[NetHack wiki](https://nethackwiki.com/wiki/Main_Page)** — More information about NetHack and its variants
